prediction_timing_samples: StaleGuard and EarlyRecovery: one approval forecast per seed; Fixed-EarlyRecovery: no prediction computation. Pre-dispatch recovery lead is recorded separately, not as negative action latency. Use-Time Recheck: one check per flight. PPR: one sample per actual periodic check; per-flight total/max computation, observation-to-decision/recovery delay and timing-bound overruns are separate. FBS: approval-time feature/EMA update and TTL freeze per flight; FBS cumulative observation computation is reported only if recorded.
